summary: Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Su-24M bomber in occupied Crimea using specialized drone operators. Defense Minister Oleksiy Fedorov resigned, with Acting Defense Minister Aleksey Viskub appointed. Multiple drone attacks reported across Ukraine targeting infrastructure and military assets.
key_points: Ukrainian Special Services Center 'Omega' destroyed Russian Su-24M bomber at an airfield in occupied Crimea using two precision-guided drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82704).
Defense Minister Oleksiy Fedorov resigned, with Acting Defense Minister Aleksey Viskub appointed as interim (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31682).
Verkhovna Rada approved new government ministers including Sergey Koretskyi as Prime Minister (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31668).
Multiple drone attacks reported in Poltava, Kharkiv, Kyiv, and other regions targeting military and civilian infrastructure (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69013, @kpszsu/68749, @mon1tor_ua/69006).
Russia claimed destruction of two Ukrainian railway locomotives in Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @tass_agency/385561).
Ukraine conducted another prisoner exchange, receiving 501 bodies from Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31670).
Drone attacks damaged Russian oil refinery in Yaroslavl region (Source: @eRadarrua/101276).
Ballistic missile threat detected from Taganrog, Russia (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014).

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian forces destroyed a Russian Su-24M bomber in occupied Crimea using specialized drone operators. Defense Minister Oleksiy Fedorov resigned, with Acting Defense Minister Aleksey Viskub appointed. Multiple drone attacks reported across Ukraine targeting infrastructure and military assets.

points: Ukrainian Special Services Center 'Omega' destroyed Russian Su-24M bomber at an airfield in occupied Crimea using two precision-guided drones that struck the nose and fuel tanks (Source: @UkraineNow/82704).

Defense Minister Oleksiy Fedorov resigned, citing incomplete organizational transformation of the Ministry of Defense to NATO standards and failure to fully restructure the military leadership (Source: @UkraineNow/82677).
Verkhovna Rada approved new government ministers including Sergey Koretskyi as Prime Minister, while Defense and Foreign Affairs minister positions remain vacant (Source: @UkraineNow/82701).
President Zelenskyy announced potential meeting with Putin in Turkey, with Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba supporting the initiative (Source: @UkraineNow/82695).
Ukrainian drones with artificial intelligence reportedly reduce Russian conscripts' survival time to 20-30 minutes on the battlefield (Source: @UkraineNow/82690).
Russian forces claimed destruction of two Ukrainian railway locomotives in Dnipropetrovsk region used for military cargo transport (Source: @tass_agency/385561).
Drone attacks damaged Russian oil refinery in Yaroslavl region, impacting fuel production and supply chains (Source: @eRadarrua/101276).
Russian police released Boris Nadezhdin after administrative violation protocol related to banned FBK video content (Source: @tass_agency/385533).
Russian military reported drone attacks on strategic aviation base 'Engels-2' in Saratov region, causing fires (Source: @eRadarrua/101243).
Ballistic missile threat detected from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014).
Drone attacks reported in Kharkiv region, including reactive drone activity toward Balakliia from the south (Source: @kpszsu/68755).
Multiple drone strikes in Dnipropetrovsk region, including attacks on Poltava and Kamianske (Source: @eRadarrua/101278).
Railway infrastructure targeted in Dnipropetrovsk region with claimed destruction of locomotives (Source: @tass_agency/385561).
Drone activity detected near Kupiansk and Mala Danilivka in Kharkiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/101275).
Drone attacks reported in Chernihiv region, including activity near Ripa southwest of the regional center (Source: @kpszsu/68730).
Ballistic missile threat detected from Taganrog targeting northern regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014).
Drone activity in Zhytomyr region moving west through Chopovychi and Narodichy (Source: @kpszsu/68736).
Drone attacks in Mykolaiv region targeting infrastructure (Source: @kpszsu/68714).
Ballistic missile threat from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69014).
Drone activity in Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/68714).
Ukrainian Special Services Center 'Omega' destroyed Russian Su-24M bomber in Crimea using precision-guided drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82704).
Multiple drone attacks across Ukraine including Shahed-136/131 types targeting Kyiv, Poltava, and other cities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69006, @mon1tor_ua/69013).
Drone attacks on Russian oil refineries in Yaroslavl and Engels regions (Source: @eRadarrua/101276, @eRadarrua/101243).
Ukrainian claims of 91% interception rate for drones and 87% for cruise missiles using new systems (Source: @DeepStateUA/23654).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain numerical superiority but face increasing Ukrainian drone capabilities, particularly with AI-guided munitions reducing Russian casualty survival times. Ongoing drone attacks target critical infrastructure across Ukraine, including energy facilities and transportation networks. Russian oil refineries face sustained drone assaults, potentially impacting fuel logistics. Ballistic missile threats from Russian territory pose immediate danger to Ukrainian cities. The resignation of Ukraine's Defense Minister signals potential organizational restructuring challenges amid active combat operations.
sections.regional_response: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen sought shelter in Kyiv during air raid sirens during her visit (Source: @tass_agency/385564). NATO allies continue supporting Ukraine's defense modernization efforts, including Patriot missile system procurement. Turkey remains a potential mediator for future peace negotiations between Ukraine and Russia. Sanctions impact Russian economy, particularly in agricultural and energy sectors, while Ukrainian forces leverage asymmetric warfare tactics effectively.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian drone operations demonstrate increasing sophistication with AI-guided munitions and coordinated multi-drone strikes. Russian military logistics face disruption through targeted attacks on fuel infrastructure and transportation networks. Political instability in Ukraine's defense ministry may affect operational coordination. Prisoner exchanges continue at 501:31 ratio favoring Ukraine. Russian security services investigate assassination attempts linked to Ukrainian intelligence operations.
